install.notes: The upstream clone has no setup.py, pyproject.toml or requirements file. Its modules import gym, pybullet, numpy, matplotlib and torch (drone_envs/envs/drone_env_v0.py:1-11, run.py:1-20); none of them is installed by this package, and the checked fake backend needs only the SDK. The implicit sim backend (gym.make) would need gym and pybullet and was not run.
